response.sql: WITH grouped_income AS (SELECT link_to_member, SUM(amount) as member_total FROM income WHERE link_to_member IS NOT NULL GROUP BY link_to_member), total_calculated AS (SELECT SUM(member_total) as grand_total FROM grouped_income), with_shares AS (SELECT link_to_member, member_total, member_total * 1.0 / (SELECT grand_total FROM total_calculated) as share FROM grouped_income), avg_share_calc AS (SELECT AVG(share) as avg_share FROM with_shares), above_average AS (SELECT member_total, share FROM with_shares WHERE share > (SELECT avg_share FROM avg_share_calc)) SELECT SUM(member_total) as total_of_sums, AVG(share) as average_of_shares, AVG(share - (SELECT avg_share FROM avg_share_calc)) as average_of_differences FROM above_average
